issues.legal_issue: For a possession suit concerning a notified Sikh Gurdwara within the specified municipal area, a pre-existing committee assigned to that Gurdwara is not treated as constituted on the date the Gurdwara is notified.
material_facts: The plaintiff committee managed Gurdwaras within the municipal limits, had been constituted before 1930, and was the committee concerned with the suit Gurdwara under the Act.
The final decision in the proceedings concerning the properties was made on 16 June 1936, followed by a notification concerning the Gurdwara on 3 March 1937.
The possession suit was filed on 25 February 1938, more than one year after the final decision.
issues.conclusion: The date of the notification concerning the Gurdwara could not be treated as the date of constitution of the committee for the limitation rule. The suit was barred by limitation and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 25-A, a possession suit must be brought within one year from the date of the decision or the date of constitution of the committee, whichever is later. Section 86 concerns notified Gurdwaras other than those specified in section 85. For committees described in section 85, section 88(2) deems the publication date of the committee's constitution notification to be its constitution date. That deeming rule does not permit substituting the later notification concerning a Gurdwara for the committee's constitution date. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: statutory_gurdwara_possession_suit and committee_covers_gurdwara_by_area and committee_existed_before_final_decision and filing_more_than_year_after_final_decision

predicates.statutory_gurdwara_possession_suit: A committee brought a statutory suit before the designated tribunal seeking possession of property associated with a Sikh Gurdwara.
predicates.committee_covers_gurdwara_by_area: The existing committee's remit included the Gurdwara because it was within the area covered by that committee.
predicates.committee_existed_before_final_decision: The committee had already been constituted before the final decision concerning the property.
predicates.filing_more_than_year_after_final_decisi: The possession suit was filed more than one year after the final decision concerning the property.

issues.definition: When a statutory Gurdwara possession suit concerns a Gurdwara covered by a committee that existed before the final decision, and the suit is filed more than a year after that decision, the suit is barred by limitation.
